title: Put treatment reminders in notification channel
body: The treatment reminder notifications end up in Other/Uncategorised. It would be helpful to have them in a notification channel so that sound, vibration and other preferences could be customised in Android settings. On my phone, these notifications are currently silent, and I always miss them.
